REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION
TUESDAY - JUNE 30, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Safety Center service counter, 18135 Bloomfield Avenue (Sheriff's Station), Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Safety Center service counter during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to code_enforcement@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1203 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to code_enforcement@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Safety Center service counter no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
5A.
Approval of Minutes
Tuesday, May 26, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Property Preservation Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.
Minutes of May 26, 2026
6.
Public Hearings
6A.
Review and consideration of a case sent before the Property Preservation Commission finding that conditions constituting a property nuisance, as defined in Chapter 6.20 of the Cerritos Municipal Code, exist at 19204 Almadin Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, including a lack of landscape maintenance, dead vegetation, a lack of adequate ground cover, and dying vegetation. Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION FINDING THAT THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 19204 ALMADIN AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7054-025-053) CONSTITUTES A PROPERTY NUISANCE AS SET FORTH IN CHAPTER 6.20 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, AND SETTING FORTH A TWENTY-ONE (21) DAY ABATEMENT PERIOD THEREON.
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2026-22
Agenda Report
6B.
Review and consideration of a case sent before the Property Preservation Commission finding that conditions constituting a property nuisance, as defined in Chapter 6.20 of the Cerritos Municipal Code, exist at 13240 Destino Place, Cerritos, California, 90703, including overgrown vegetation and a lack of landscape maintenance.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION FINDING THAT THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 13240 DESTINO PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7027-007-008) CONSTITUTES A PROPERTY NUISANCE AS SET FORTH IN CHAPTER 6.20 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, AND SETTING FORTH A SEVEN (7) DAY ABATEMENT PERIOD THEREON.
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2026-23
Agenda Report
7.
Reports
7A.
Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
7B.
Reports from Property Preservation Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
8.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION
COMMISSION HELD TUESDAY, JUNE 30, 2026, 7:00 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT
CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Westphal.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the Property Preservation Commission were in attendance:

  Commissioner Jignesh Chokshi
  Commissioner Eric Westphal
  Vice Chair Brian Ferrer
  Chair Celia Spitzer

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Chokshi, and seconded by Vice Chair Ferrer, to
  excuse Commissioner Robles from the Property Preservation Commission Regular
  Meeting of June 30, 2026.

  The motion carried (4 – 0 – 1 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chokshi, Westphal, Ferrer, Spitzer
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Robles
  ABSTAIN:  None

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Spitzer opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals
  who provided written correspondence or elected to speak, Chair Spitzer declared the
  public comments period closed.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Tuesday, May 26, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Property Preservation Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Westphal, and seconded by Commissioner
  Chokshi, to approve the Tuesday, May 26, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Property Preservation
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes, as presented.

  The motion carried (4 – 0 – 1 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chokshi, Westphal, Ferrer, Spitzer
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Robles
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Tuesday, July 28, 2026, 7:00 p.m.
Property Preservation Commission Regular Meeting  Page 2 of 4

6.  Public Hearings

6A.  Review and consideration of a case sent before the Property Preservation Commission
  finding that conditions constituting a property nuisance, as defined in Chapter 6.20 of
  the Cerritos Municipal Code, exist at 19204 Almadin Avenue, Cerritos, California,
  90703, including a lack of landscape maintenance, dead vegetation, a lack of adequate
  ground cover, and dying vegetation.

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION FINDING THAT THE PROPERTY
  LOCATED AT 19204 ALMADIN AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703 (APN 7054-025-053)
  CONSTITUTES A PROPERTY NUISANCE AS SET FORTH IN CHAPTER 6.20 OF THE
  CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE AND SETTING FORTH A TWENTY-ONE (21) DAY
  ABATEMENT PERIOD THEREON.

  Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2026-22

  A staff report was given by Senior Code Enforcement Officer Kim Aardema on the
  subject property with the recommendation that the Property Preservation Commission
  adopt the subject resolution as presented in the agenda report.

  Chair Spitzer opened the public hearing and public comments period. Noting there were
  no individuals who provided written correspondence or elected to speak, Chair Spitzer
  declared the public comments period and public hearing closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Ferrer, and seconded by Commissioner Westphal,
  to:

  1. Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. P.P.C. 2026-18, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION FINDING THAT
  THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 19204 ALMADIN AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA
  90703 (APN 7054-025-053) CONSTITUTES A PROPERTY NUISANCE AS SET
  FORTH IN CHAPTER 6.20 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE AND
  SETTING FORTH A TWENTY-ONE (21) DAY ABATEMENT PERIOD THEREON;
  and

  2. Direct staff to transmit the adopted resolution and report from the Property
  Preservation Commission to the City Council; and

  3. Direct staff to serve upon the responsible persons in accordance with Section
  6.20.100(a) of the Cerritos Municipal Code the adopted resolution ordering the
  abatement of the property nuisance.

  The motion carried (4 – 0 – 1 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chokshi Westphal, Ferrer, Spitzer
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Robles
  ABSTAIN:  None

6B.  Review and consideration of a case sent before the Property Preservation Commission
  finding that conditions constituting a property nuisance, as defined in Chapter 6.20 of
  the Cerritos Municipal Code, exist at 13240 Destino Place, Cerritos, California, 90703,
  including overgrown vegetation and a lack of landscape maintenance.

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Tuesday, July 28, 2026, 7:00 p.m.
Property Preservation Commission Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 4

6B.  (continued)

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION FINDING THAT THE PROPERTY
  LOCATED AT 13240 DESTINO PLACE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7027-007-
  008) CONSTITUTES A PROPERTY NUISANCE AS SET FORTH IN CHAPTER 6.20 OF THE
  CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, AND SETTING FORTH A SEVEN (7) DAY ABATEMENT
  PERIOD THEREON.

  Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2026-23

  A staff report was given by Code Enforcement Officer Brian Lane on the subject
  property with the recommendation that the Property Preservation Commission adopt
  the subject resolution as presented in the agenda report.

  Chair Spitzer opened the public hearing and public comments period. Noting there were
  no individuals who provided written correspondence or elected to speak, Chair Spitzer
  declared the public comments period and public hearing closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Chokshi, and seconded by Commissioner
  Westphal, to:

  1. Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. P.P.C. 2026-19, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CERRITOS PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION FINDING THAT
  THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 13240 DESTINO PLACE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
  (APN 7027-007-008) CONSTITUTES A PROPERTY NUISANCE AS SET FORTH
  IN CHAPTER 6.20 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE AND SETTING
  FORTH A SEVEN (7) DAY ABATEMENT PERIOD THEREON; and

  2. Direct staff to transmit the adopted resolution and report from the Property
  Preservation Commission to the City Council; and

  3. Direct staff to serve upon the responsible persons in accordance with Section
  6.20.100(a) of the Cerritos Municipal Code the adopted resolution ordering the
  abatement of the property nuisance.

  The motion carried (4 – 0 – 1 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chokshi, Westphal, Ferrer, Spitzer
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Robles
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  Reports

7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison

  Code Enforcement Manager Joseph Chacon reported that the Code Enforcement
  Division is increasing enforcement efforts regarding unpermitted front-yard and
  parkway modifications to ensure consistent and fair application of the Cerritos Municipal
  Code.

7B.  Reports from Cerritos Property Preservation Commissioners

  There were no reports from the Property Preservation Commissioners.
